title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: Palm Beach & Tripoli are LIVE!
description:
Welcome back to the weekly MSFS 2024 Marketplace update for PC. This week, March 7, 2026, brings a solid lineup of must-have airports including KPBI Palm Beach and HLLT Tripoli. We also see a huge wave of "DreamScenery" night enhancements and water fixes to make your sim look better than ever.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 NetDesign: CYSH Smiths Falls‑Montague Airport (Detailed Canadian regional airport)
🛫 Azrsim: HLLT Tripoli International Airport (Major international hub in Libya)
🛫 SPINOZA: KCIC Chico Regional Airport (Regional airport in California)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KEKO Elko Regional Airport (High‑desert regional operations)
🛫 Verticalsim: KPBI Palm Beach International Airport (Popular US East Coast international airport)
🛫 HRSimYard: LOIE Heliport RK2 (Specialized heliport operations)
🛫 BackwoodStudios: OG13 Fly By Night Airstrip (Challenging bush‑style airstrip)
🛫 LuchoDev: SCFA Andres Sabella International Airport (Key Chilean international airport)
🛫 DC Scenery: SDLP Lencois Paulista (Regional Brazilian airport)
